跟着做：单机节拍与产能: Follow Along: Cycle Time and Capacity
产线课的套路：先跑起来看现象 → 想清楚瓶颈在哪 → 改一个参数 → 再跑、看目: The line lesson workflow: get it running and observe → identify the bottleneck → change one parameter → run again and check whether the target numbers changed → submit. Next lesson, we'll add a few more machines.
车间只有一台加工中心 **M1**，做一件要 **75 秒**；毛坯平均 **4:
The workshop has only one machining center, **M1**, which takes **75 s** to process one part. Raw castings arrive every **45 s** on average and pile up in the pre-machining buffer, **B0**.
Adjust the **incoming interval** to keep M1 as busy as possible without creating a long queue of raw castings. **Success criteria**: In
产线课不写程序，改的是工厂模型的参数，跑仿真看结果。: The line lesson doesn't involve writing code. Change parameters in the factory model and run a simulation to see the results.
点工作台第二行绿色的「**运行**」。右上角的仿真时钟走到 10 分钟左右（嫌慢: Click the green "**Run**" button on the second row of the Workbench. Let the simulation clock in the upper right reach about 10 min (increase the speed next to it if you want to go faster).
先看现象再动手：来得比做得快，多出来的毛坯只能排队。: Observe before making changes: when parts arrive faster than they can be processed, the extras have to queue up.
运行按钮在工作台顶上第二行，「重置」右边。倍速选 10× 或 60× 会快很多。: The Run button is on the second row at the top of the Workbench, to the right of "Reset." Set the speed to 10× or 60× to go much faster.
点「带我去」选中 **B0**（待加工缓存），右边属性里能看到里面有多少件；再看: Click "Take Me There" and select **B0** (the pre-machining buffer). The Properties panel on the right shows how many parts it contains. Then check that M1 is processing continuously. Is the number of parts in B0 increasing? Click "Next" when you're done.
排队的时间全算进生产周期，所以周期会越来越长。: Queueing time is included in the production cycle, so the cycle keeps getting longer.
回答：M1 每小时最多做多少件？: Answer: What is the maximum number of parts M1 can produce per hour?
打开任务面板的「**目标与作答**」，选出 M1 每小时最多能加工多少件。: Open **Goals & Answers** in the task panel and select the maximum number of parts M1 can process per hour.
产能 = 3600 秒 ÷ 单件用时。75 秒一件，一小时最多 48 件。: Capacity = 3600 s ÷ processing time per part. At 75 s per part, the maximum is 48 parts per hour.
点「带我去」选中 **SRC**（来料），在右边属性的「节拍」里把**到达间隔*: Click "Take Me There" to select **SRC** (Incoming). In the "Cycle Time" section of the Properties panel on the right, change the **arrival interval** from `expo(45)` to a value slightly greater than 75, such as `80` (one part arrives every 80 s).
来料间隔比加工时间稍大：M1 几乎一直有活干，B0 里又不会越堆越多。只能改来料: Set the arrival interval slightly longer than the processing time: M1 will have work almost continuously, and the queue in B0 will not keep growing. Only the arrival interval can be changed. M1's cycle time represents the equipment's capacity and is fixed at its original value for grading.
属性面板在工作台右边；参数按分组折叠，展开「节拍」那一组。: The Properties panel is on the right side of the Workbench. Properties are grouped and collapsed; expand the "Cycle Time" group.
再跑，看目标变成 ✓: Run again and check that the goals show ✓
点「**运行**」接着跑（或者先点「重置」从头跑）。「目标与作答」里每小时产出和: Click **Run** to continue (or click "Reset" first to start over). The hourly output and average production cycle in "Goals & Answers" update in real time. You are done when both show ✓.
运行中的数字是估计值；提交后服务器用固定随机种子跑 8 小时正式评分。: Values during the run are estimates. After submission, the server runs the official 8-hour grading simulation with a fixed random seed.
间隔太小会排队（周期超标），太大产量不够。75 秒的加工，间隔取 76～83 秒: If the interval is too short, parts will queue up (exceeding the cycle-time target); if it is too long, output will be too low. For a 75 s processing time, an interval of 76–83 s works.
点任务面板上绿色的「**提交评分**」。: Click the green "**Submit for Grading**" button in the task panel.
